findings: Claims constant-time safety while actual cswap branches on secret bits, pointAdd branches on secret intermediates and cpp_int arithmetic is variable-size. Equal high-level operation counts are insufficient.
modInverse returns zero for zero although no inverse exists.
Fixed 256-bit scalar loop silently discards higher bits and has no negative-input guard.
Affine formula conditions omit vertical-line and y=0 exceptions in prose; characteristic >3 and modulo-p nonsingularity missing.
ECDLP difficulty overstated for all curves and as exhaustive-search only; Pollard rho and subgroup order distinction needed.
ECDH omits public-key validation, authentication and KDF; CDH is a distinct problem from DLP.
Self heading uses old Japanese path instead of configured slug; cryptocurrency Crypto substring, Euclide substring and Jacobian biography links are misleading.
Key-strength table lacks source/scope and rounds length ratios.

primaryReferencesRead.scope: Abstract; §§2.3,3 affine formulas,3.3 parameters/discriminant,4 ECDH,10 attack algorithms/subgroups,10.2 authentication and10.3 invalid-point attack excerpts. Not full signature sections or entire standard.
§5 conditional swap and5.1 side-channel caveats, plus introduction. Not implementing X25519/X448 and no full RFC review.
§5.6.1.1/Table2 parsed text pp54–55, interpretation of modulus versus base-point-order bit length; no full document/current adoption policy review.
cpp_int arbitrary precision, allocation parameters, signed magnitude, exception behavior; runtime tests use Ubuntu Boost1.83, not1.85.
